items.title: Benny Powell interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 16, 1999 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: I remember seeing my first kind of art film, color in relation to notes, and I remember the soundtrack was played by Oscar Peterson

ctx.x: I love to hear it. Absolutely. How did you end up in Ottawa?

I was with Lionel Hampton’s band and I think it was my first time being outside of the United States. At this time I wasn’t even 20 or 21. Between racial prejudice and some kind of petty things that went on with this organization, things I thought were petty, I was kind of fed up. When I finally was exposed to another culture in Canada where being black was an asset rather than a liability, I remember the president of the jazz club was a big judge, Judge Enger in Ottawa, and I said wow, this is another level. I…
Was there enough work up there for you to stay?
